extensions_update_enabled.description: If true, enables extension updates (overrides Firefox default behavior).

disable_openh264.description: If true, disables the OpenH264 codec (used for WebRTC H.264 video).

disable_enhanced_newtab.description: If true, disables enhanced (suggested) content on about:newtab (classic view only).

disable_healthreport_upload.description: If true, disables uploading of health reports (crash data, usage metrics).

disable_urlbar_search_suggestions.description: If true, disables search suggestions in the URL bar (including history/matching).
